name: Buffalo-skin salad
summary: Thái buffalo-skin salad. Vietnam.vn, on 2 April 2024, singes the skin, scrapes it to the clear layer, boils it, shocks it in cold water, slices it wide and thin, soaks it in hot water with lime juice, then seasons it with trám, garlic, sour-bamboo water, and mắc khén, and mixes roasted peanuts, herbs, banana flower, and rau dớn. Báo Sơn La, on 4 September 2020, says the sour note is sour-bamboo water, not vinegar or lime, and names roasted peanuts. The lime and the no-lime accounts both stay.
origin: Vietnam.vn, 2 April 2024. Báo Sơn La, 4 September 2020. Báo Sơn La, 2 July 2021, also names the salad with forest banana flower.
texture: Báo Sơn La says the skin is worked until it is soft, chewy, and crunchy. Vietnam.vn shocks it in cold water for the crunch.
taste: Báo Sơn La, on 4 September 2020, calls it sour and fragrant, lightly sweet, and bùi from roasted peanuts. Vietnam.vn does not print that taste line.
howToEat: As the salad. The hour and a price are Check on arrival.
where: The Thái table. Neither account names a street.
